mostWorthwhile.text: Adding ATP was most worthwhile because it connected the energy supply to both protein building and the membrane pump.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing and then placing the protein machinery felt a little repetitive, although the pictures made the two stages clear.

surprise.text: The pump moved particles from a less crowded area to a more crowded one, showing a different use for ATP than building proteins.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary. The RNA message was linked to DNA, though I would have liked a clearer explanation of how the copy was made.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how working cells connect to tissues, though the mostly predictable fitting steps make that a tentative yes.
